name: Monogram opens into the full lockup and CTA
looks: A single-letter monogram mark sits alone on a dark ground, then cuts to the full wordmark with its second word in the accent colour, a two-line promise underneath, a rounded CTA button, the site URL, and a small trust line in fine print at the very bottom.
build: Monogram holds alone for a short beat, then hard-cuts to the full lockup group arriving together (`y:10px -> 0`, power2.out, ~350ms). The CTA button lands last with a small scale overshoot (0.95 -> 1.02 -> 1); the trust line fades in last, well below the button, at reduced opacity.
sound: A soft low swell under the cut to the full lockup, a light pop on the CTA button's arrival.
prompt: Hold on a lone monogram mark, then cut to the full brand lockup: wordmark with one word in the accent colour, a short two-line promise, a CTA button arriving last with a touch of overshoot, the site URL, and a small trust line in fine print beneath everything.
